min_standing_note.value: Undergraduate exchange courses are open to Bachelor students; graduate exchange courses require a completed relevant Bachelor's degree (or equivalent >=3 years university study).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Mapped from Excel agreement scope 'Business Administration' to AUC School of Business (BUS).

instruction_languages.notes: All exchange courses are taught in English; Swedish and Norwegian speakers may request Danish-taught courses.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Incoming exchange students must document English proficiency (no explicit RHET 1020 exemption stated). CBS English Proficiency FAQ specifies IELTS Academic 7.0, TOEFL iBT 94 (Home Edition accepted; selective graduate courses may expect higher), Cambridge CAE >=185 / CPE, or Duolingo 130 unless exempt via full English-taught degree in an accepted English-speaking country (Denmark excluded).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Verbatim PDF URL extracted from CBS 2025-2026 Promotional Toolkit DOCX; documentation requirement also in Fact Sheet #page=4.

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-taught exchange courses. CBS offers an optional pre-semester Danish crash course (https://www.studieskolen.dk/en/cbs/crashcourse) and a credit-bearing semester Danish language course.

fall_term_dates.value: Autumn semester (AY 2026-2027): 1 Sep 2026 - 31 Jan 2027 (Danish crash course 17-21 Aug 2026; latest arrival 24 Aug 2026; mandatory Introduction Programme 25-28 Aug 2026; exams Oct-Dec/Jan).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring semester (AY 2026-2027): 1 Feb 2027 - 30 Jun 2027 (Danish crash course 18-22 Jan 2027; latest arrival 25 Jan 2027; mandatory Introduction Programme 26-29 Jan 2027; exams Mar-Jun).

tuition_model.notes: Nominated exchange students from official CBS partner universities do not pay tuition fees to CBS (pay regular tuition to home institution); distinct from fee-paying freemovers.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: CBS fact sheet and retrieved cbs.dk pages list living expenses as a topic without publishing an official CBS monthly DKK/EUR total budget; non-CBS third-party estimates excluded.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Cannot be derived without an official CBS monthly living cost estimate.

housing_notes.value: Limited amount of non-guaranteed housing for incoming exchange students via CBS Housing Department (privately owned dorms; link sent via email to registered exchange students; apply late May for Autumn / mid-Nov for Spring via cbs.dk/housing). Private housing supplement facilitated in Autumn semester only.
housing_notes.notes: Direct housing instructions link from 2025-2026 Promotional Toolkit DOCX: https://www.cbs.dk/en/study/internationals/exchange-students/housing/how-to-apply-student-residences.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA citizens must have their Danish student residence permit processed prior to arrival (unless eligible for visa-free travel to Denmark). EU/EEA citizens apply for a residence certificate if staying >3 months; Nordic citizens need no residence permit.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Danish SIRI financial proof requirement is DKK 7,426/month (DKK 89,112/year) per https://www.nyidanmark.dk/en-GB/You-want-to-apply/Study/Higher-education.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS; normal full-time semester workload is 30 ECTS (4 courses x 7.5 ECTS = ~825 total study hours).

course_restrictions_note.value: Autumn course catalog publishes mid-March and Spring catalog mid-September; course selection occurs late April (Autumn) / late October (Spring). Graduate courses require completed Bachelor's degree.

value: Home university nomination (via CBS form to inboundexchange@cbs.dk)

campus_type.notes: Fact Sheet #page=2 states: 'CBS has an urban campus in Frederiksberg, an integrated part of Copenhagen.'

international_support_services.value: Mandatory Introduction Week, optional pre-semester Danish crash course (https://www.studieskolen.dk/en/cbs/crashcourse), and Buddy Programme with airport pick-up.

nomination_deadlines.value: Autumn/Full Year: Nomination 15 April; Exchange application & course selection late April; Accommodation late May. Spring: Nomination 15 October; Application & course selection late October; Accommodation mid-November (2024 cycle dates in PDF #page=4).
nomination_deadlines.notes: Confirmed recurring 15 Apr / 15 Oct nomination schedule at https://www.cbs.dk/en/study/exchange-students/application-and-deadlines.
